transcript: Speaker A: कहाँ जा रहे हो? [Where are you going?] Speaker B: I going office. Speaker A: अरे "I am going to the office" बोलो। अगर ऐसी ही प्रोफेशनल इंग्लिश बोलनी है तो Speak Easy ऐप ट्राई करो। [Hey, say "I am going to the office". If you want to speak professional English like this, try the Speak Easy app.] Speaker B: पर मेरे पास क्लासेस के लिए इतने पैसे नहीं हैं। [But I don't have that much money for classes.] Speaker A: चिंता मत करो, यह कोचिंग से बहुत सस्ता है। सिर्फ ₹1 में ट्रायल स्टार्ट करो और रोज मेरे साथ 10 से 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करो। [Don't worry, this is much cheaper than coaching. Start a trial for just ₹1 and practice with me for 10 to 15 minutes daily.] Speaker B: सही है, मैं अभी डाउनलोड करता हूँ। [Great, I'll download it right now.] Speaker C: अभी Speak Easy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the Speak Easy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: kahan ja rahe ho [Where are you going] / I going office / Aree I am going to the office bolo [Hey, say I am going to the office] / app try karo [try the app] / classes / hai. chinta mat karo [Don't worry] / sirf ₹1 mein trial [trial for just ₹1] / practice karo [practice] / Speakeasy AI / Speak English Easily with Speakeasy / Install Now / GET IT ON Google Play
summary: An AI robot corrects a driver's English grammar in a split-screen setup. The robot pitches the Speakeasy AI app as an affordable alternative to coaching classes, offering a trial for just ₹1. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app for fluent English.
